findings.criterion: Human takeover excludes AuraCall browser automation
findings.consequence: Puppeteer commands bypass guardedCdp and can compete with native human input
findings.reproducer: Create a Puppeteer connection to the owned endpoint, take a human claim, then send Runtime.evaluate through Puppeteer
findings.repair: Use a guarded Puppeteer CDP transport with per-command admission through the same resolver and actual response settlement
findings.verification_evidence: Real WebSocket regression plus actual Chrome/Puppeteer established-session refusal, connection refusal and post-release resumption

findings.criterion: Config changes never silently reuse a running browser on a different desktop; root is explicit
evidence: src/browser/index.ts root path calls generic reuseRunningChromeProfile
src/browser/service/browserService.ts non-native branch falls back to generic endpoint resolution
findings.consequence: Changing a native browser profile to root can reuse its still-running native browser
findings.reproducer: Retain a live native browser then select root for the same managed directory and invoke public launch/endpoint resolution
findings.repair: Refuse root launch/reuse/endpoint admission when exact retained native ownership still exists
findings.verification_evidence: Live retained profile/explicit-endpoint regressions and actual public root-launch refusal

findings.criterion: Conflict messages and passive client remain usable without displacing another controller
evidence: src/http/desktopClientPage.ts stores claims before take and retains all errors
claims object uses prototype-bearing JSON object lookup
findings.consequence: A refused second takeover leaves an unowned local claim blocking passive viewing; configured constructor desktop is misread as a retained claim
findings.reproducer: Refuse take before acquiring a human claim, refresh; select a ready desktop named constructor
findings.repair: Return authoritative claim-retained state for known refused takeover, clear only positively unowned local claims, use a prototype-free claim map
findings.verification_evidence: Actual HTTP definitive-refusal/unknown distinction; rendered constructor desktop and refused-take passive restoration; uncertain issuance retains pause
